title: "06 Immunofluorescence quantification (Fig. 7B, Supplementary Fig. 4)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(plyr)
```


```{r}
path = here::here("data", "AB_quantification")
```

# Fig 7B IL1B
```{r}
IL1B <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 4, nrow = 0))

# EI
base_dir = paste(path,"IL1B/EiB tiff",sep="/")

file_list = fs::dir_ls(base_dir, glob = '*_Results.csv$')
for(i in file_list){
  result = read.csv(i)
  fileName = strsplit(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]] [length(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]])] , split ='-')[[1]][1]
  IL1B <- rbind(IL1B, data.frame(fileName,mean(result$Mean),nrow(result),Type="EI"))
}

#EN
base_dir = paste(path,"IL1B/EN tiff",sep="/")

file_list = fs::dir_ls(base_dir, glob = '*_Results.csv$')
for(i in file_list){
  result = read.csv(i)
  fileName = strsplit(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]] [length(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]])] , split ='-')[[1]][1]
  IL1B <- rbind(IL1B, data.frame(fileName,mean(result$Mean),nrow(result),Type="EN"))
}


#HC IL1b.HC.08.11.23 tiff
base_dir = paste(path,"IL1B/IL1b.HC.08.11.23 tiff",sep="/")

file_list = fs::dir_ls(base_dir, glob = '*_Results.csv$')
for(i in file_list){
  result = read.csv(i)
  fileName = strsplit(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]] [length(strsplit(i,split = '/')[[1]])] , split ='-')[[1]][1]
  IL1B <- rbind(IL1B, data.frame(fileName,mean(result$Mean),nrow(result),Type="HC"))
}

colnames(IL1B) <- c("file_Name", "Mean", "Cells","Type")
IL1B$AB <- "IL1B"

IL1B$Type <- factor(IL1B$Type, c("HC","EN","EI"))

IL1B
```


```{r}
ggboxplot(IL1B, x = "Type", y = "Mean" ,group_by="Type", fill = "Type", main = "IL1B", xlab = "", ylab = "mean expression of IL1B" , palette = c("EN" = "#01c7e1","EI" = "#fe2504","HC" = "#ffc700"))+
          theme(text = element_text(size = 15))+  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + theme(legend.position="right")

```

```{r}
ggboxplot(IL1B, x = "Type", y = "Mean" ,group_by="Type", fill = "Type", main = "IL1B", xlab = "", ylab = "mean AB expression" , palette = c("EN" = "#01c7e1","EI" = "#fe2504","HC" = "#ffc700"))+
          stat_compare_means(method = "anova")+
          stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "t.test",ref.group = ".all.")+
          geom_hline(yintercept = mean(IL1B[,c(2)]), linetype = 2)+
          theme(text = element_text(size = 15))+  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + theme(legend.position="right")
```

```{r}
res.aov <- aov(Mean ~ Type, data = IL1B)
# summary(res.aov)
TukeyHSD(res.aov)
```
